newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Chronology of anti-government protests in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of anti-government protests in Bahrain.

text.p: Following is a chronology of anti-government protests in Bahrain:
Dec 5, 1994 - Protesters demand release of Sheikh Ali Salman, Shi'ite Moslem cleric arrested after distributing leaflets calling for restoring parliament dissolved in 1975.
Jan 18, 1995 - Bahrain deports Sheikh Salman and two other clergymen, Sheikh Hamza al-Deiri and Sheikh Haidar al-Sitri.
April 1 - Police arrest Sheikh Abdul-Amir al-Jamri, two other clergymen. At least one killed, 16 wounded in clashes.
Sept 25 - Sheikh Jamri released.
Dec 16 - Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa pardons prisoners including undisclosed number of Shi'ite detainees.
Dec 31 - Bomb explodes at commercial centre causing damage but no injuries. Another bomb fails to go off.
Jan 13, 1996 - Interior Ministry summons eight opposition leaders including Sheikh Jamri and warns them to stop using mosques to fan anti-government riots or face legal action.
Jan 17 - Bomb at Le Royal Meridien Hotel causes damage.
Jan 22 - Bahrain says it arrests eight Shi'ite opposition leaders, including Sheikh Jamri, for inciting protests.
Jan 31 - Bahrain orders Iranian diplomat to leave for activities incompatible with diplomatic status.
Feb 1 - Iran expels Bahraini diplomat in Tehran.
Feb 8 - Interior Ministry says it holds lawyer and writer Ahmed al-Shamlan, first member of Sunni branch of Islam, to which ruling al-Khalifa family belongs, to be detained.
Feb 11 - Bomb blasts Diplomat Hotel, wounding three people.
Feb 23 - Interior Ministry identifies four men accused of carrying out wave of bombings.
Feb 24 - Explosion wrecks car of chief editor of al-Ayam newspaper, causing damage but no casualties.
March 6 - Blast at National Bank of Bahrain kills one, wounds two. Security forces allege victim was bomber.
March 14 - Seven Bangladeshi workers die when suspected arsonists set restaurant ablaze on island of Sitra.
March 19 - Bomb at Baisan Hotel causes fire and damage.
March 26 - Isa Ahmed Hassan Qamber, convicted of murdering police sergeant in 1995, executed by firing squad.
May 5 - Wave of arson attacks destroys two shopping malls and badly damages buildings and stores in Manama.
May 7 - Couple and son, three, killed and four people wounded when blast hits house in Shi'ite village.
June 3 - Bahrain says it foiled pro-Iranian plot to topple government. Around 60 suspects arrested.
July 1 - Court orders execution of three men accused of an arson attack in March which killed seven Bangladeshis.
Aug 18 - Bahraini held by police dies of heart attack.
Sept 16 - Asian killed in arson attack on two stores in Shi'ite village.
Jan 2, 1997 - Asian killed, two wounded in arson attack in Shi'ite village.
March 1 - Trials begin of 81 accused of involvement in alleged pro-Iranian attempt to topple government.
March 17 - Amnesty International urges Bahrain to halt trials which it says are "grossly unfair".
March 26 - State Security Court sentences 16 people accused of involvement in plot to prison terms of three to 15 years. Lawyers say 10 suspects acquitted.
